commits.message:
fix(daemon): a shutdown puts the tmux status lines back after its own tmux calls land, before it waits on the renderer (#775)

* fix(daemon): a shutdown puts the tmux status lines back before it waits on the renderer

* test(daemon): a close puts the tmux status lines back while its renderer has not answered

* test(daemon): the close test runs tmux at exit as a blocking call

* test(daemon): the restore tests share one private tmux server, and the close test always ends its daemon

* fix(daemon): the close lets tmux calls in flight land, then restores through the reconcile's own calls

* fix(daemon): each tmux server is put back on its own at close, and a closed reconcile draws nothing more
